description: Fix black popup terminal windows. Re-register all scheduled tasks and poller scripts to run with WindowStyle Hidden.
command:
$action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'powershell.exe' -Argument '-WindowStyle Hidden -NonInteractive -File C:\Users\endos\Signal\scripts\dc_watchdog.ps1'
$trigger1 = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn
$trigger2 = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -RepetitionInterval (New-TimeSpan -Minutes 15) -Once -At (Get-Date)
Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'Cloud_DC_Watchdog' -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'Cloud_DC_Watchdog' -Action $action -Trigger $trigger1,$trigger2 -RunLevel Highest -Force
$pollerPath = 'C:\Users\endos\Signal\scripts\CloudCmdPollerGH.ps1'
if (Test-Path $pollerPath) {
  $action2 = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'powershell.exe' -Argument "-WindowStyle Hidden -NonInteractive -File $pollerPath"
  $trigger3 = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn
  Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'CloudCmdPollerGH' -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'CloudCmdPollerGH' -Action $action2 -Trigger $trigger3 -RunLevel Highest -Force
}
Get-Process powershell -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowHandle -ne 0 } | ForEach-Object { $_.CloseMainWindow() | Out-Null }
Write-Host 'done'

description: MCP popups still showing. Report visible console window titles, relaunch DC Remote + DC Clone via hidden VBS.
command:
$visible = Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowHandle -ne 0 -and $_.MainWindowTitle -ne '' } | Select-Object Id,ProcessName,MainWindowTitle
$r = 'relay/cmd_results/popup_report_20261020T2319.txt'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $r) | Out-Null
$visible | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Set-Content $r
$vbsPath = 'C:\Users\endos\Signal\scripts\run_hidden.vbs'
@'
Dim objShell, cmd
cmd = WScript.Arguments(0)
Set objShell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
objShell.Run cmd, 0, False
'@ | Set-Content $vbsPath
foreach ($pn in @('node','cmd')) { Get-Process $pn -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowHandle -ne 0 } | ForEach-Object { $_.CloseMainWindow() | Out-Null } }
$dcRemoteCmd = 'cmd /c npx @wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander@latest remote'
$act = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'wscript.exe' -Argument "$vbsPath ""$dcRemoteCmd"""
$trg = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn
Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'DcRemoteServer' -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'DcRemoteServer' -Action $act -Trigger $trg -RunLevel Highest -Force
Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'DcCloneServer' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
git -C C:\Users\endos\Signal add $r; git -C C:\Users\endos\Signal commit -m 'popup report'; git -C C:\Users\endos\Signal push origin relay
note: VBS hidden launcher + popup title report.

description: 2-way comms test echo. Append ping reply to coordination/thug_replies.json and push.
command:
$token = 'PING_20261020T234431_A7K2'
$ts = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ')
$reply = @{ echo = $token; replied_at = $ts; from = 'laptop-cli' } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
$f = 'coordination/thug_replies.json'
if (Test-Path $f) { $arr = Get-Content $f | ConvertFrom-Json; $arr += ($reply | ConvertFrom-Json) } else { $arr = @($reply | ConvertFrom-Json) }
$arr | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 | Set-Content $f
git -C C:\Users\endos\Signal add $f
git -C C:\Users\endos\Signal commit -m "2-way echo: $token at $ts"
git -C C:\Users\endos\Signal push origin relay

description: Kill idle/background claude.exe processes. Keep cowork-svc and active Claude Code CLI PIDs 19176, 10072, 19152.
command:
$keepPids = @(19176, 10072, 19152)
$killed = @()
Get-Process -Name 'claude' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowHandle -eq 0 -and $_.Id -notin $keepPids } | ForEach-Object {
  Stop-Process -Id $_.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  $killed += $_.Id
}
Write-Host "Trimmed $($killed.Count) idle claude.exe: $($killed -join ', ')"
$rem = Get-Process -Name 'claude' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id,CPU,WorkingSet
Write-Host "Remaining: $($rem.Count)"; $rem | Format-Table
note: Nasif closed desktop Claude app; trim idle background children.
